test_title: SSC CPO 2023 Official Paper-I (Held On: 03 Oct, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Which of the following is the correct statement?

options.text: Joule is the unit of work
The unit of energy is the watt.
Joule/ second is also a unit of energy.
The unit of power is joule/newton.

solution:
The correct answer is __**Joule is the unit of work**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **The joule **serves as the** unit of work and energy **within the International System of Units (SI).
 
• Named after the English physicist James Prescott Joule, who conducted pioneering experiments on the mechanical equivalent of heat, one joule is equivalent to one newton meter.
 
• I
